Fresh subtitle object has WrapStyle=0, collisions=0, SBAS=false. With no headers overriding them, soft \n is a space; outline/shadow scaling is disabled. This is the fresh-object file path, not an unknown host reinitialization path.

With no style definitions and host default-style override disabled, missing event style becomes Default then uses m_defaultStyle: Arial18 bold, scale100/100, spacing0, alignment2, margins20, outline2, shadow3; primary white, secondary yellow, outline black have transparency0, shadow black transparency128; charset DEFAULT_CHARSET. Host mutation of m_defaultStyle is excluded.

Swapping Start and End labels only in Format does not swap xy dialogue fields: event remains active at 0.5s. OpenSubStationAlpha has fixed positional style/dialogue readers and no Format dispatch. Core honors swapped labels and obtains a negative interval.

An event read after style D size20 but before differing D size40 remains bound to renamed D2 size20; a later event uses D size40. Identical duplicate definitions are discarded. No universal post-parse last-wins rule.

SSA alignment6 maps to top-center8. AlphaLevel64 applies transparency64 to primary/secondary/outline; shadow transparency128. BackColour supplies outline color, replacing TertiaryColour. ASS instead extracts each color high byte and uses keypad alignment.
Primary color after \c&H0000FF&\c&H00FF00& is green (RGB 0,255,0); this property uses ordered assignment. Do not extrapolate to placement, alignment or fade.

For \pos(40,40)\pos(240,140), anchor is (40,40). pos and move share EF_MOVE, so the first valid supported-arity pos/move occupies the slot. org separately takes its first valid two-parameter operation.

\an7\an3 produces top-left alignment7; initialized negative style alignment lets only the first an/a assignment take effect. Invalid first an falls back to original alignment and still prevents a later an.

Default20, Alt40: \rAlt A uses40; parameterless \fs then B uses original20 (org is not replaced); \rMissing C also uses original20. Bare \r resets style to original; it does not clear separately stored EF_MOVE or alignment. Reset names use exact map lookup.
From original20, \fs+2 gives24; following \fs-5 gives12; \fs0 and empty \fs restore original20. These finite small values are distinct from undefined overflow behavior.

From original normal weight400: \b-1 restores original normal (not bold); \b700 selects700. \fscx-10 clamps to0; \fscx restores original100. \fs25junk consumes numeric prefix25; \fsjunk resolves0 then original20. \1a&H1FF& narrows to byte255 transparency. These are finite small CRT conversions only, not a safe rule for NaN/infinity/overflow.

Unclosed text A{\fs40B has no closing brace, so GetSubtitle emits it as text instead of applying fs40. Closed {garbage} is consumed because tag parsing returns true even without recognized operations. No recursive brace grammar is inferred.

Tokenizer scans to the first ')' rather than balancing nested parentheses; transform's last parameter is recursively tokenized only within that slice. Exact resulting nested-transform text/animation output is not established for this witness; do not enable a general recursive grammar.

A=[1s,2s), B=[2s,3s), Z=[2s,2s): at 999999us none; 1000000 A; 1999999 A and X; 2000000 B and X; 3000000 none. A second X=[1.5s,2.5s) coexists with A then B; Z has no positive segment. No forced one-frame zero event.

m_time is RT2MS(rt-start). For move(40,40,240,40,100,200): t=100ms uses start, t=150ms uses midpoint140,40, t=200ms uses end. At100999us the local clock is100ms; transform fs20->40 over100..200ms yields20/30/40 at100/150/200ms. RT2MS is integer division by10000 reference ticks, so100999us evaluates as100ms for this active nonnegative local time.

Rendered fontSize is scaled by script/output Y and64, then CMyFont overwrites lfHeight with positive rounded size; ascent/descent come from GetTextMetrics, width from GetTextExtentPoint32W. Cannot equate font-size20 to a20-unit OpenType em or infer exact advances without the selected GDI face.

Negative style Encoding maps to DEFAULT_CHARSET; \fe128 assigns128 and empty \fe restores original charset. LOGFONTW receives charSet even for Unicode text. Byte-script conversion separately uses TranslateCharsetInfo/Windows codepages; Unicode glyph selection and legacy byte decoding are distinct.

CMyFont retries Arial only if CreateFontIndirect fails; successful font creation does not prove the requested face exists. Exact face/glyph for a deliberately missing family, Arabic, CJK and private-use U+E000 remains unknown until resolved face/font files and OS linking are captured.

ParseString constructs CText separately around overrides; measurement precedes line compaction. CWord::Append refuses differing complete styles. Nonzero spacing measures/draws one UTF16 code unit at a time. fi and Arabic joining across a color boundary may differ; exact glyph/advance changes are provisional, not a claim that GDI never shapes.

For q2, A\nB\NC\hD has three lines: A / B / C NBSP D. For q0/1/3 soft n becomes ordinary space; N always hard; h becomes NBSP, not a word delimiter. Style metrics govern empty breaks; GetNextLine halves ascent/descent for an empty line.

Mode1 leaves available width unchanged. GetNextLine groups consecutive whitespace/nonwhitespace CWords, accepts a group if it fits or line is empty, otherwise retries it on next line; overlong first word is retained. Exact break words require captured font metrics, not guessed glyph widths.

For full line width F and available M>0, minwidth=F/(abs(F)/M+1) with integer division. Accumulate words while width<minwidth and abs(width+word)<abs(M). Mode3 additionally subtracts last word when width<F and F-width+lastWord<M; mode0 does not. Then GetNextLine uses that width. Concrete break words cannot be fixed without GDI measurements.

Zero event margins inherit original event-style margins before scaling. Without pos/move, MakeLines chooses left=marginL, center=(marginL+width-marginR-boxWidth+1)/2, right=width-marginR-boxWidth; bottom=height-marginBottom-boxHeight, middle=(marginTop+height-marginBottom-boxHeight+1)/2, top=marginTop (integer internal units). Resetting to Alt does not replace original event margins.

Fresh allocator displaces only same-layer intersecting rectangles. Bottom align1..3 search up; middle/top4..9 search down. pos/move, org and animated style transforms bypass allocation. collisions=reverse is parsed but allocator explicitly has TODO and does not implement reversed collisions.

Line stores rounded max outlineWidthX/Y; spaceNeeded width=max(lineWidth+borderX), height=sum(ascent+descent). First/last line borderY affect allocator rectangles via CRect(0,topBorder,0,bottomBorder). This describes layout inputs only; no stroke/blur algorithm or exact ink expansion is approved.

ParseScript sorts active events by ascending layer then readorder; file ingestion defaults readorder to entry ordinal. Overlapping explicit-position events with same start/layer remain source-ordered. Equal custom readorder tie order is not established and excluded.

Allocator retains active entries across adjacent segments. With A0..1s and B0.5..2s, sequential sampling at0.75s then1.25s can preserve displaced B after A ends; fresh seek to1.25s can place B at its default anchor. This is a source-derived conflict candidate, not a captured outcome. C1 forbids history dependence: keep this capability blocked; architect must choose a deterministic canonical policy or explicit separately reviewed contract change.

No exact legacy rule established for 1e999, NaN or integers outside CRT range. wcstod/wcstol plus unchecked casts do not establish safe portable semantics. Probe captures must run bounded in disposable Actions Windows environment; Taiyou limits/error guarantees remain mandatory.
